item.title: Nintendo's 'Switch 2 Holiday Experience' Might Be Coming To A City Near You Next Month (US)

description.p: Try out some 2026 hits.Nintendo's making sure that everyone has a Switch 2 on their wishlist this Christmas, as it has today announced the 'Nintendo Switch 2 Holiday Experience', which will be coming to select cities in the US over the next month.Running from 25th November to 23rd December, the pop-up will feature playable demos for a bunch of Switch 2's finest (Pokopia, Mario Kart World, Ocarina of Time, Splatoon Raiders, and more), and give you a chance to see them all in both handheld and docked mode.Read the full article on nintendolife.com

item.title: Zelda: Ocarina Of Time Remake Crowned 2026's "Best-Selling Physical Video Game In The US"

description.p: "After just one week".The Zelda: Ocarina of Time remake for Switch 2 got off to an outstanding start, selling over five million copies (approx 5.2 million units) in just four days. Sales in the UK and Japan have contributed to this, and now, Circana Retail Tracking Service has shared data about the title's US launch.As highlighted by Circana's senior director and video game industry advisor Mat Piscatella (via social media), "after just one week", Ocarina of Time for Switch 2 is this year's "best-selling physical video game in the US". Interestingly, it's the first title to surpass one million physical units in a US launch week since the 2023 Switch title, The Legend of Zelda: Tears of the Kingdom.Read the full article on nintendolife.com

item.title: NBA 2K27 Brings A Slice Of GTA 6's Vice City To Switch 2 This Month

item.title: Shigeru Miyamoto To Receive The Inaugural 'Legend Award' At The 30th D.I.C.E. Awards

description.p: Award will be presented only once per decade.The Academy of Interactive Arts & Sciences (AIAS) has announced that Shigeru Miyamoto, the creator of iconic Nintendo franchises like Super Mario and The Legend of Zelda, will receive the inaugural Legend Award at the upcoming 30th Annual D.I.C.E. Awards ceremony on Thursday, 18th February 2027.The award, which will only be presented once per decade, 'recognises an industry icon whose enduring vision continues to redefine interactive entertainment'. It's designed to honour creators whose achievements have already earning lasting universal acclaim, while celebrating their 'immeasurable impact and influence'.Read the full article on nintendolife.com

item.title: "That Was Very Tough" - Indiana Jones Dev Struggled To Transition From Gunplay

description.p: Whipped into shape.Indiana Jones and the Great Circle is one of the biggest surprises in recent years. Developer MachineGames, well known for its ability to make gunning down Nazis immensely satisfying in its Wolfenstein franchise, created what is arguably the best Indy adventure since The Last Crusade.Yet transitioning from Wolfenstein wasn't exactly easy for the studio. In a new interview with the FRVR podcast (thanks, VGC), design director Jens Andersson explains how the developers found it "very tough" to focus on melee combat, given its expertise in gunplay.Read the full article on nintendolife.com

item.title: Dave The Diver's Latest Crossover Update Sees Another Beloved Indie Join The Fray

description.p: Hook, line, and Core Keeper.Since its arrival on Switch a few years back, Dave The Diver has crossed over with just about every other indie game imaginable (a slight exaggeration, but you get our point). Today, developer Mintrocket has announced yet another of these crossovers for its roster, as it is teaming up with Fireshine Games and Pugstorm on some new two-way Core Keeper content.This crossover update launches on 30th November in both games, with the sandbox survival title gaining some new Blue Hole paraphernalia, and the beloved diving/bar management sim going all mine-y. item.title: Random: Modder Transforms DS Into A Home Console, And It's Super Cool

description.p: Meet the DualStation.We have long pondered what a DS library would look like on Nintendo Switch Online for some dual-screen, big-screen action. Nintendo is yet to give us the real deal, so modder KOUZEX has taken things into his own hands, creating a build that converts our beloved clamshell into a full-blown home console. And yes, it's super cool.The above video introduces the DualStation, a mod build that combines an original DS motherboard and a bunch of unique components into a system that boasts quite an impressive array of features. We're talking full 60Hz HDMI output, touch controls via just about any means you can think of (controller, mouse, Joy-Con, drawing tablets), Bluetooth controller support, a built-in mic and a bunch of other bells and whistles.Read the full article on nintendolife.com
